g.text: 1) Video codec: A video codec is a method that compresses and decompresses

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: video so it takes less space and bandwidth. It removes repeated or less

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: important visual information while trying to keep the video looking good.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Different codecs trade off encoding speed, device support, how small the file

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is, and visual quality. Common codecs: H.264, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1, MPEG-2.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Video container: A video container is the file format that holds the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: compressed video, audio, subtitles, and metadata in one file. Think of it as

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the outer box; the codec is how the contents inside are packed. One

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: container can hold many different codecs, so the file extension alone does

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: not tell you which codec is used. Common containers: MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Bitrate: Bitrate is how much data per second is used to represent the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: video, usually measured in kbps or Mbps. Higher bitrate usually means better

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: potential quality, but also larger files and more bandwidth use. The right

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: bitrate depends on resolution, frame rate, how complex the video content is,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and how efficient the codec is. Bitrate can be constant (CBR) or variable

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) Manifest files: Modern streaming does not send one big video file. Instead,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the video is split into short segments and each version (different resolution

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and bitrate) is listed in text-based manifest files. The primary (master)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: manifest lists all available versions of the video and points to media (variant)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: manifests. Each media manifest lists the URLs of the short segments for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: one specific quality level. The player reads the primary manifest, chooses a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: quality level, downloads segments in order, and can switch between qualities

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: as network conditions change. This system is called adaptive bitrate

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: streaming (ABR) and is used in HLS and MPEG-DASH.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5) How they fit together: Codec: how the video is compressed. Container:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: what file format holds video, audio, and metadata. Bitrate: how much data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: per second is used, effecting quality and bandwidth. Manifest file:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instructions/index telling the player what versions exist and which segments

g.text: 1) Handling video processing to support adaptive bitrate streaming.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Split up the original file into segments (using a tool like ffmpeg or similar).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: These segments will be transcoded (converted from one encoding to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: another) and used to generated different video containers.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Transcode (convert from one encoding to another) each segment and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: process other aspects of the segments (audio, transcript generation).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Create manifest files referencing the different segments in different video

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Video is split into small chunks (about 5-10 MB), each with a unique

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Video metadata stores a list of chunks, each with its fingerprint and a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The client first sends this chunk list to the backend with all chunk

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The client uploads each chunk to Amazon S3; S3 returns a part number

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and ETag for each uploaded part.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The client sends part number and ETag to the backend, which verifies

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: them with S3 and marks the matching chunk as Uploaded.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - After all chunks are uploaded, the client calls CompleteMultipartUpload; S3

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: emits a single object-level event that can trigger further processing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - If the upload is interrupted, the client can resume by reading

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: VideoMetadata and only re-uploading chunks that are not yet marked as

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Storing video: uploading video with presigned url has been already covered

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - bad solution: raw video uploaded. As different devices require different

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: video formats in order to play back video.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Good Solution: using a video processing service to upload back raw video

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: uploaded on s3 in various formats. Uploading entire video poses challenge for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the next requirement of streaming video.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - great solution: using a video processing service uploading video in different

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - bad solution: download entire video on the client side and then watching.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Issues: huge wait time, if network distruption is there the download fails.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Good solution: The client would choose a video format based on the user's

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: device, bandwidth, and preferences and then go on to download segments

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instead of entire video. this way segments can be streamed along the way.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Issues: doesnt account for flactuating network constraints while a user is

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Great Solution: Adaptive bitrate streaming. This is an upgradation to the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: previous approach. Uses the manifest file which has references to all the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: video segments that are available in different formats. If there is a slowing

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: down of network the client will attempt to download more compressed, lower

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: resolution segments to avoid any interruption in streaming.
